comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtainable from Coliseum for 1,500 Roman Coins -- you must defeat Whirlwind Olaf to make this item available for purchase at the Coin Exchange shop; only x1 can be bought at a time.

You will randomly receive the following:

Scandinavian Meatballs
Scandinavian Herring Pie
Ostkaka
Northern European Pancakes
Freya's Drink
Loki's Goblet
Thor's Thunder
Viking Treasure
Record of Vikings

Source: GMs (support ticket)
